title: Trace2Tower: Transition-Aware EigenTrace Induction of Multi-Level Skills for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.05261v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model agents increasingly rely on execution traces to master complex interactive tasks. However, current paradigms are bottlenecked by shallow trajectory retrieval and flat skill summarization, fundamentally ignoring the temporal dependencies and outcome-conditioned topology of agent behavior. We introduce Trace2Tower, a transition-aware EigenTrace framework that distills raw trajectories into a robust skill hierarchy. Trace2Tower abstracts step-level interactions into canonical events, constructing a unified graph governed by semantic compatibility, transition dynamics, and outcome evidence. Through a novel contrastive spectral decomposition, it isolates stable, success-aligned behavioral modes while rigorously suppressing failure-prone shortcuts. These modes organically populate a dynamic skill tower of action templates, procedural routines, and overarching task strategies, continuously refined via verifier-guided feedba

translated_title: Trace2Tower：面向LLM智能体的转移感知特征迹多层技能归纳方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体日益依赖执行轨迹来掌握复杂的交互式任务。然而，当前范式受到浅层轨迹检索和扁平化技能总结的瓶颈制约，从根本上忽略了智能体行为的时间依赖性和以结果为条件的拓扑结构。我们提出了Trace2Tower，一个转移感知的特征迹框架，能够将原始轨迹提炼成稳健的技能层级。Trace2Tower将步骤级交互抽象为规范事件，构建了一个由语义兼容性、转移动态和结果证据共同约束的统一图。通过新颖的对比谱分解方法，它能够分离出稳定的、与成功对齐的行为模式，同时严格抑制容易导致失败的捷径。这些模式有机地填充到一个动态技能塔中，涵盖动作模板、程序性例程和总体任务策略，并通过验证器引导的反馈持续优化。
tldr: Trace2Tower提出了一种转移感知的特征迹归纳框架，通过对比谱分解将智能体执行轨迹提炼为包含动作模板、程序例程和任务策略的多层动态技能塔，从而提升LLM智能体掌握复杂交互任务的能力。
en_tdlr: Trace2Tower introduces a transition-aware EigenTrace framework that distills raw agent trajectories into a dynamic multi-level skill tower—spanning action templates, procedural routines, and task strategies—via contrastive spectral decomposition, enabling LLM agents to master complex interactive tasks.
